description: This source file defines a singly linked list data structure with capabilities to add, remove, retrieve elements, and compute size. It includes an internal Node class and a companion object for utility functions.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with basic operations such as add, remove, get, and size.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding a String data and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list. Returns true if removal was successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the linked list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index in the list.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private method to unlink a node from the list by adjusting previous node's next reference.
